context_for_next_testing_agent: Enable Recurrence and Add Rundown Item features fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: POST /api/shows/{show_id}/enable-recurrence (converts non-recurring to recurring), POST /api/shows/{show_id}/rundown (creates rundown items), PUT /api/shows/{show_id}/recurrence (updates recurrence settings), POST /api/shows/{show_id}/stop-recurrence (stops recurring). WordPress REST API integration remains MOCKED.
